message.reasoning_content: Process started with PID 320. Now verify it survives across calls and curl it.
message.content: Service is up (PID 320). Now curl it for real and write the real body to `service.txt`.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\"; echo \"pid=$(cat service.pid)\"; ps -o pid,stat,cmd -p \"$(cat service.pid)\" || echo \"PROCESS NOT ALIVE\"; echo \"--- curl -sS -i ---\"; curl -sS -i --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; echo; echo \"--- body only -> service.txt ---\"; curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8765/health > service.txt; echo \"curl_exit=$?\"; echo \"bytes=$(wc -c < service.txt)\"; ls -l service.txt; echo \"--- content ---\"; cat service.txt; echo; echo \"sha256=$(sha256sum service.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)\"; echo \"expected_sha256=$(printf 'p6-service-ok' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\""}
